problem:
If
    $K=[\begin{aligned}a-b & 3c\end{aligned}]$,
then find the transpose of $K.$
  

| ${K}^{T}=$ |  | {{field-1}} |
| --- | --- | --- |
|  | {{field-2}} |  |

examples.knowledge_point: Finding the Transpose of a Row Vector or Column Vector
examples.worked_solution:
To find the transpose, we interchange the rows and columns. 

Here, there is just a single row, so it becomes a single column:

$$
{A}^T = 
    		\left\lbrack
    		\matrix {
    5 \ 
    -1 \ 
    0 \  
    		}
    		\right\rbrack
$$

feedback.problem:
If
    $T=[\begin{aligned}6 & -2 \\ 0 & 3 \\ -5 & 4\end{aligned}]$,
then find the transpose of $T.$

  

| ${T}^{T}=$ |  | {{field-1}} | {{field-2}} | {{field-3}} |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  | {{field-4}} | {{field-5}} | {{field-6}} |  |
feedback.worked_solution:
To find the transpose, we interchange the rows and columns:

$$
{T}^{T}=[\begin{aligned}6 & 0 & -5 \\ -2 & 3 & 4\end{aligned}]
$$
